correctness.rationale: Exact product-rule identity reduces the composed equation to (1); p-denominator forces b=1+kp, 2-adic denominator forces t<=2, higher odd-prime valuations force squarefree u. Direct factorization-based independent checker compared 15980 bounded tuples and 1080 large-exponent probes with no mismatches. Numerical checks are supplementary, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A248815 is a natural published arithmetic-function composition equation. The theorem gives a quantified classification on an infinite domain of even two-prime inputs whose \(p-1\) has at most two odd prime factors, including the exponent relation \(b=p+1\) conditional on \((p-1)/2\) prime, a second exact family \(b=1\), and the sole \(p=61\) mixed-support exception. The prime-support and valuation restrictions are structural, not arbitrary numerical cutoffs. Safe-prime infinitude remains unproved and is not required.
